classification.difficultyReason: Quarter circle cut out of a corner: infer the radius from the differences in the sides, replace the removed edges with the arc and keep the right boundary lengths.

content.prompt: Calculate the perimeter of this shape. Answer to 1 d.p.

answer.worked:
The dashed radii are not part of the perimeter. The radius is $15-11=4\text{ cm}$, and the right angle gives $\theta=90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}P&=15+5+11+9+l\\P&=40+\frac{90}{360}\times2\pi(4)\\P&=40+2\pi\\P&\approx46.3\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
